patches.reason: Namespace host compiler dependencies; meter scoped local/upvalue lookup, definition creation and shifts during parsing

Namespace host compiler dependencies; preserve nested tail-call options; meter instruction emission, register/constant construction and generator loops across all nested functions, with protected shared recursion guards
Namespace host compiler dependencies; charge deterministic linker work before scans and recursive traversal; release temporary error state after quota failure
Namespace host compiler dependencies; meter AST node construction during parsing
Namespace host compiler dependencies; meter grammar loops and array shifts, guard block/expression recursion, and release temporary roots on quota exceptions
Namespace host compiler dependencies; meter scanner work and consumed bytes, pre-charge variable-width long-string delimiter comparisons
Avoid eager excluded peripheral dependency during local completion
Select shipped LWJGL3 guest key IDs without Minecraft host detection or host spoofing
Resolve and restore terminal redirects consistently in boot/current-thread tabs; resize tab windows before delivering term_resize to their programs
Serialize booleans and exact numeric Lua literals without relying on non-Lua-5.2 percent-q behavior
Scope ephemeral compiler work callbacks and recursive generation counters with protected restoration and exact return arity; keep host callbacks and temporary counters out of stored prototypes

notes: rc.copy retains its upstream attribution to https://lua-users.org/wiki/CopyTable.
No native executables, bytecode loaders, host IO tooling, world API adapters, or Minecraft artwork are included.
ROM sources are inert resources; packaging into a guest source registry and execution are separate integration steps.
